summary: Forum Markets filed an 8-K disclosing an October 2, 2026 First Amended and Restated LLC Agreement with Edge Node Inc. forming Forum Edge AI LLC, a data center and compute joint venture for LandCo and EquipCo project SPVs. Forum holds 51% and is sole manager; Edge Node holds 49%, with pro-rata capital calls, consent rights, distribution waterfall and non-funding remedies. A milestone-based equity exchange would have Forum issue shares equal to 9.95% of its outstanding stock for 9.95% of Edge Node's fully diluted equity. No deal price, premium or close date is stated; risk-arb focus is dilution and milestone timing.
